title: Chapter 1284 - 33: Magic Origin Fruit Tree

Chapter 1284 - 33: Magic Origin Fruit Tree

Chapter 1284: Chapter 33: Magic Origin Fruit Tree

The Great Saint Feng Zhu and other peerless Great Saints appeared dazed.

Before Lin Yuan made his move.

They envisioned countless possibilities.

There was the possibility of the Galaxy Great Saint directly storming into the small continent, sweeping through the various dimensional native beings, and ultimately plucking the Magic Origin Fruit, retreating with them safely.

Or the Galaxy Great Saint using the Space-Time Rule insights to instantly appear beside the Magic Origin Fruit tree and leave with the fruit before the numerous dimensional native beings could react.

Or the Galaxy Great Saint employing special means to suppress all dimensional native beings in a short time and then easily taking the Magic Origin Fruit.

And so on.

They had considered various possibilities.

But the premise of all these possibilities was that the Galaxy Great Saint would undoubtedly deploy his true self.

After all, compared to the true self, an incarnation is much weaker.

Even if one has incredible means and insights into the rules, a weak physical and mental state cannot perform them.

But now, the scene of the Galaxy Great Saint reaching out to grasp the entire Magic Origin Fruit tree was performed by an incarnation.

This left all the peerless Great Saints somewhat silent.

The scene was too unimaginable.

Could an incarnation be this powerful?

Or what level of true self would allow for an incarnation so easily formed to be this strong?

...

"Where is this?"

The Magic Origin Fruit tree was uprooted and suddenly awakened.

As a rare treasure born of the dimensional gap, the Magic Origin Fruit tree itself possessed a certain level of intelligence.

Even secretly influencing the many dimensional native beings on the small continent.

Otherwise, with the preciousness of the Magic Origin Fruit tree, it would have long been divided and devoured by those dimensional native beings, before the Eye of Myriad Laws even discovered it?

But at this moment, the Magic Origin Fruit tree, which had a decent capacity for self-preservation, was shivering.

Its leaves trembling uncontrollably.

The dimensional gap is boundlessly mysterious, where thirteenth-tier time life forms are colossal beings capable of roaming through the gaps.

There are also some life forms below the thirteenth tier, all birthed from the dimensional gap, whose power in such a harsh environment is far more potent than those born in the Chaos Void.

The Magic Origin Fruit tree itself belonged to this category, and to it, the actions of the Great Saint Feng Zhu and other peerless Great Saints seemed like child’s play.

Even if the fissure connecting to the Chaos Void didn’t close in three days, the Great Saint Feng Zhu and other peerless Great Saints would still fail to pluck the Magic Origin Fruit.

Originally, the Magic Origin Fruit tree planned to wait until the Great Saint Feng Zhu and other peerless Great Saints delved deeper before making a move to consume them.

Unexpectedly, Lin Yuan arrived.

"Too powerful."

"Is this a life born within a dimensional space?"

The Magic Origin Fruit tree trembled with fear.

Throughout its drifting in the dimensional gap, it had encountered numerous terrifying beings.

But compared to Lin Yuan, the difference was colossal.

Lin Yuan reshaped its understanding of life below the thirteenth tier.

...

Chaos Void.

The Eye of Myriad Laws was closely monitoring the situation on the small continent, and naturally witnessed the moment Lin Yuan reached out and covered the sky.

"This power?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws couldn’t believe it.

Originally, he thought Lin Yuan sending an incarnation lightly was a bit arrogant.

But to his surprise, even just an incarnation was this terrifying?

"The power of an incarnation exceeds all the Invincible Great Saints in history?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws’ thoughts spread; although he was ecstatic about Lin Yuan obtaining the Magic Origin Fruit, such terrifying strength left him unsettled for a long time.

If not for the certainty that Lin Yuan hadn’t yet reached the thirteenth tier, he might suspect whether a time life form had intervened.

"What kind of monster is this..."

The Eye of Myriad Laws gazed distantly, feeling deeply moved.

Previously, he thought the reason he couldn’t see through Lin Yuan’s incarnation was some Secret Technique being used to obstruct him.

But now, he realized it was simply because the incarnation was too powerful, surpassing his limit of perception.

"What level of power does the Galaxy Great Saint’s true self possess?"

The Eye of Myriad Laws couldn’t help but be curious, but he also realized he probably would never know.

Just an incarnation possessed such power, who in the Chaos Void could force the Galaxy Great Saint’s true self to act with all his might?

The spirits of those special places?

Not to mention that the spirits of special places couldn’t act.

Even if they could, they likely wouldn’t match the Galaxy Great Saint’s incarnation now.

Let alone the true self of the Galaxy Great Saint.

In the view of the Eye of Myriad Laws, only the thirteenth-tier could force the Galaxy Great Saint’s true self to act with full force.

But the thirteenth-tier time life forms were the least likely to take action.

In fact, the thirteenth-tier time life forms wouldn’t even pay attention to things happening in the Chaos Void.

Their eyes and minds were primarily focused on the distant future, as for the past and present? Only if an event occurred that affected the foundation of the Chaos Void.

For instance, if a special place were completely destroyed.

Otherwise, it’s tough to draw the attention of time life forms of the thirteenth tier.

"I wonder if that person knew that the legacy left behind would cultivate an existence like the Galaxy Great Saint..."

The Eye of Myriad Laws pondered.

The ’that person’ he referred to was the founder of the "Infinite Void" and one of the time life forms of this Chaos Void.

Over the long Cosmic Era, the "Infinite Void" had been passed down through various cultivators, and the Eye of Myriad Laws witnessed them all.

But Lin Yuan? The combined strength of all cultivators who inherited the "Infinite Void" in history probably wouldn’t withstand a single slap from the Galaxy Great Saint.

More accurately, wouldn’t withstand a single slap from the Galaxy Great Saint’s incarnation.

...

"Very smooth."

Lin Yuan reached out and retrieved the entire Magic Origin Fruit tree without encountering any fierce resistance.
